subject: Marine Works - Diving Operations - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Diving Operations - Vancouver Harbour
Diving Operations East of Second Narrows, on the South side of the channel near the FRPD McKenzie derrick in the vicinity of 49 17.650N 123 01.155W.
Hours of Operation;
Day 1, 30 Oct 2026 2330 UTC to 31 Oct 2026 0330 UTC,
Day 2, 31 Oct 2026 2345 UTC to 01 Nov 2026 0500 UTC,
Day 3, 02 Nov 2026 0130 UTC to 02 Nov 2026 0630 UTC,
Day 4, 03 Nov 2026 0300 UTC to 03 Nov 2026 0830 UTC.
Mariner requested to detour North a minimum of 100 meters.
During active diving operations, the following vessel traffic measures will apply:
 - 100 metres separation is required from the dive operation.
 - Light tugs and commercial vessels may be permitted to transit on the north side of the channel at a slow but safe speed, provided the required separation can be maintained.
   - Should your tier 2 vessel require a lift of the Second Narrows Rail Bridge, it should be entered into the Centralized Scheduling System.
- Tier 1 vessels and tug & barges will be unable to transit during the times posted above. Please plan your transits around these scheduled times.
Vessels monitoring VHF Channels 12, 16 and 69.
Minimum wash
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1502-26
